remarks: Welcome to Camarillo Mobile Estates, a 55+ gated manufactured-home community centrally located in Camarillo! This 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home sits on a large corner lot and features new appliances, shutters, and a covered porch currently being used as an additional bedroom. There is so much more to discover! Enjoy a convenient location near shopping, dining, and the Camarillo Premium Outlets. Community amenities include a clubhouse, swimming pool, spa, fitness center, billiards and game areas, shuffleboard, green space, laundry facilities, and RV storage. The monthly space rent is $2,224.80.
